paper: Theoretical Investigation on Inductive Bias of Isolation Forest
iforest_detection: expected depth of x1 is strictly smaller than every normal point
knn_detection: mean distance to the k nearest neighbors of x1 is strictly larger than every normal point
required_assumptions: normal points x2:n are sorted and unique

verdict_rule.VERIFIED: all literal implications hold and no admissible counterexample is found
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: an independently reproduced counterexample satisfies every recorded assumption and contradicts a literal quantified statement
verdict_rule.BLOCKED: evidence is incomplete or the source quantifier cannot be resolved
